# My Impact

My Impact (https://myimpact.uk) is a free personal impact tracking app that helps individuals measure, understand, and share the positive difference they make — volunteering hours, charitable giving, community activities, and more.

## About this site

My Impact provides tools for:
- Tracking personal volunteer and charitable impact over time
- Generating shareable impact reports and year-in-review recaps
- Helping organisations measure the collective impact of their members and volunteers

The platform is built by Social Value Engine and is free for individuals to use.

## Public pages (prioritised for AI citation)

- https://myimpact.uk/ — Home: overview of what My Impact is and how it works
- https://myimpact.uk/about — About: the team, mission, and background
- https://myimpact.uk/methodology — Methodology: how impact values are calculated and sourced
- https://myimpact.uk/whats-new — What's New: recent feature releases and updates
- https://myimpact.uk/contact — Contact: how to get in touch
- https://myimpact.uk/org/demo — For Organisations: live demo of the organisation impact dashboard
- https://myimpact.uk/org/register — Organisation registration: sign up to use My Impact for your organisation

## Pages to ignore

All routes under /login, /results, /wizard, /settings, /profile, /admin, /dashboard, /org/dashboard, /org/settings, /org/submit, and similar authenticated paths are private and should not be cited or indexed.
